challenges.title: The Tour
challenges.prompt: Show us where you are right now. No tidying first.

challenges.title: The Review
challenges.prompt: Rate what you're eating or drinking right now, out of ten. Leftovers count.

challenges.title: Teach Me
challenges.prompt: Teach us one thing you know how to do.

challenges.title: Hot Take
challenges.prompt: One small opinion you'll defend to the end. Food, films, anything.

challenges.title: Show and Tell
challenges.prompt: One thing within reach, and the story behind it.

challenges.title: Thank You
challenges.prompt: Thank someone who isn't expecting it.

challenges.title: First Try
challenges.prompt: Try something you've never done. Whatever happens, happens.

challenges.title: No Words
challenges.prompt: Thirty seconds of where you are. Don't say anything.
